Opens a large, value-focused retail channel that can drive GMV and ad revenue for Instacart.
Near-term volume test; early traction could signal scale potential.
Nationwide reach would materially increase assortment and order density.
Delivery in as fast as 1 hour
Improves value proposition vs peers; supports frequency and retention.
Adds non-grocery essentials and discretionary mix, aiding basket size.

This extends Instacart’s marketplace reach into discount retail, aligning with a trend toward value channels. A larger catalyst requires confirmation of rollout timing, adoption metrics (orders/store), and revenue or ads uplift in subsequent updates.
